bullets.title: CSCO: -7% on GM headwinds despite AI order strength
bullets.body: Cisco fell ~7% after reporting lower gross margin guidance despite strong AI and enterprise orders. Hardware product mix shift (hyperscale/AI) is pressuring GMs; Citi TMT notes the 'Buy the Stock' dynamic means CSCO is underperforming sector peers like ANET. Stock feels 'full' per Mizuho.

bullets.title: COHR: -7% on margin disappointment; bull case intact per Mizuho
bullets.body: COHR fell ~7% on earnings despite a revenue beat, with gross margins coming in at the low end of expectations. Mizuho pushes back: COHR is guiding to $3B quarterly revenue within 4 quarters (vs. consensus $2.7B), will achieve and then raise its 42% GM target, and CPO program ramp in 2H27 remains on track with bookings extending to 2028–2030. JPM also notes COHR disappointed vs. peer LITE which beat with 50.4% GMs (+140bps vs. consensus) and got a PT raise to $1,000.

bullets.title: DELL/HPE: sympathy rally on Lenovo blowout; DELL +288% YTD
bullets.body: DELL +4% and HPE +3.4% pre-market on Lenovo earnings sympathy — Lenovo reported infrastructure solutions revenue +100% YoY and AI-related revenue +60% YoY. Mizuho notes DELL is up 288% YTD with 50-60% revenue and 85-100% EPS growth; it has outperformed STX, MU, AMD, and LITE. HPE also benefiting from enterprise server/storage demand surge.

bullets.title: CRM: JPMorgan resumes at Overweight; +1.9% pre-market
bullets.body: JPMorgan resumed coverage of Salesforce with an Overweight rating, driving the stock up ~1.9% pre-market. No price target cited in sources but the upgrade is the primary catalyst. DT (Dynatrace) also received an Outperform initiation from Wolfe (PT $65) following its $915M Arize AI observability acquisition, expected to add ~200bps to ARR growth.

bullets.title: NVDA: AI financing platform mobilizes $500B; Burry Enron comparison surfaces
bullets.body: NVDA is near June highs at ~$224 with Mizuho overweight into Aug 26 earnings as a key catalyst. MS notes NVDA announced a $500B financing platform to address 'circularity' concerns by pulling in pension funds and sovereign wealth as infrastructure debt buyers. On the bear side, Michael Burry drew a comparison between NVDA and Enron, though this is a single data point. The Economist also covered NVDA's tension with hyperscaler customers building competing silicon.

bullets.title: CRWV/NBIS: neocloud earnings beat; compute demand tight, pricing at highs
bullets.body: CoreWeave (CRWV) beat on active power and margins with >$25B in early-Q3 commitments; Nebius (NBIS) beat topline and raised FY26 contracted power targets with positive Q3 trends. Both names are off slightly in pre-market (-1.5% and -2.5% respectively) after runs. CoreWeave is raising prices 25% as Blackwell pricing hits new highs, reflecting tight compute supply.

bullets.title: IREN: delivers Horizon 1 to MSFT, achieves NVIDIA GB300 Exemplar Cloud status
bullets.body: IREN delivered its 50MW Horizon 1 cloud deployment to Microsoft at Childress, Texas and became the first to achieve NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status on the GB300 NVL72 platform. IREN is targeting 480MW AI Cloud capacity in 2026 and 1.2GW gross AI Cloud capacity in FY27.

bullets.title: AAOI: strong coherent-wavelength demand surge; 1.6T ramp not yet in numbers
bullets.body: Multiple sources flag enormous CW (coherent-wavelength) demand imbalance driven by NVDA ramp. AAOI and SIVE are emerging as scarce, independent CW laser/transceiver capacity holders. The 1.6T hyperscaler ramp scaling from H1 to H2 2027 is not yet reflected in current demand figures. AAOI -1.7% pre-market after the LITE/COHR earnings volatility.

bullets.title: TEAM/TTD/ADBE/DKNG: tech conf day 1 key takeaways
bullets.body: TEAM management tone positive on seat expansion, cross-sell, and AI (Teamwork Graph/MCP); JSM gaining traction; enterprise underpenetrated. TTD flagged headwinds broader than discussed on the earnings call. ADBE margins under pressure in next FY guide due to freemium transition costs ahead of usage scaling. DKNG's 2026 optics hinge on NFL (Sept, neutral) vs. NBA (late-Oct, negative near-term/better 2027) prediction market launch timing.

bullets.title: AMD: files debt shelf registration of indeterminate amount
bullets.body: AMD filed both a 424B5 and an S-3ASR automatic debt shelf registration of indeterminate amount, with Barclays, BofA, Citi, JPM, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo as joint book-runners. Stock was at $482.93 at filing. BofA also raised its 2030 server CPU market forecast to $210B+ (from $170B, nearly 5x 2025 levels) on AI agent demand, benefiting AMD and INTC.

bullets.title: GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN: hyperscalers benefit from open-weight AI efficiency; remain top picks
bullets.body: MS TMT notes open-weight models drive healthy returns for hyperscalers via higher token throughput efficiency. JPM names AMZN, GOOGL, SPOT as top large-cap internet picks. Pershing Square (PSUS) expects hyperscaler margins to expand and CapEx-to-sales ratios to decline over 2-3 years as AI data center investments mature. GOOGL remains underweight concern: up only 9% YTD, leadership changes in AI and Gemini advanced model gaps weighing on stock per Mizuho, though firm argues underestimation is persistent.

bullets.title: LRCX/CDNS: JPM conf takeaways bullish on WFE outlook and agentic AI EDA
bullets.body: LRCX raised its AI capex-to-WFE framework from ~$8B to $9-10B per $100B of AI capex and lifted WFE industry outlook from ~$135B to ~$150B for 2026; mid-50% GM and mid-40% OM targeted. CDNS sees record Q1-Q2 backlog with recurring EDA revenue +18-20% YoY; agentic AI tools (ChipStack, ViraStack) cut design cycles from ~5 weeks to days; Intel 14A engagement is a multi-year opportunity barely in near-term numbers.

bullets.title: SHOP/CLS: Canadian mid-morning outperformers
bullets.body: Shopify (SHOP) trading +2.6% and Celestica (CLS) +4.4% on the TSX mid-morning. No specific fundamental catalyst cited beyond the broader market move.

bullets.title: ABNB: Jefferies raises PT to $215 from $175
bullets.body: Jefferies raised its Airbnb price target to $215 from $175, consistent with broader travel/hospitality PT upgrades seen across the Street today.

bullets.title: META: $567M liability ruling in NM; smart glasses criminal complaint in Germany
bullets.body: New Mexico court found Meta liable for harm to young users and ordered it to pay $567M. Separately, a German privacy group filed a criminal complaint alleging Meta's smart glasses enable covert filming; German prosecutors are reviewing. Meta also removed 750K+ teen accounts in Australia under compliance mandate.

bullets.title: RKLB: ATM 'repapering' not new dilution — $1.9B is residual from existing $3B program
bullets.body: Commentary clarifies that the $1.9B RKLB ATM headline is reuse of remaining capacity from the $3B program established in May 2026, not incremental dilution. H1 2026 ATM proceeds were approximately $1.53B.

bullets.title: DELL/HPE/CSCO: Citi flags margin compression risk spreading from AAPL to enterprise hardware
bullets.body: Citi TMT flags that AAPL flipped the hardware narrative negative on 7/30 with softer guidance and margin pressure, CSCO added to the pressure, and the concern is now whether DELL/HPQ/NTAP will follow. The Q3 theme shifts from 'Buy the Group' to 'Buy the Stock' — ANET outperforms CSCO, LITE outperforms GLW/COHR, STX outperforms WDC as key pair trades.

bullets.title: DIS/NFLX/LYV: MS LA Media Bus Tour Sept 28-29 with C-suite access
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's September 28-29 LA Media Bus Tour features Walt Disney CFO Hugh Johnston (Sept 28 AM), Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos (Sept 29 PM), and Live Nation CFO/IR. Event limited to select hedge funds; request deadline August 26.

bullets.title: DELL: 52-week high, +254% YTD; MDB +120%, NET +61% also at highs
bullets.body: StreetAccount flags 171 stocks at 52-week highs: DELL at $501.50 (+254% YTD), MDB at $457.90 (+120% YTD), NET at $325 (+61% YTD), PANW at $395.40 (+125% YTD), LYV also at a high (+18% YTD).

bullets.title: ORCL: anchor tenant for Vantage Data Centers exploring $100B IPO
bullets.body: Vantage Data Centers is exploring going public at approximately $100B valuation, with ORCL identified as its anchor tenant for Stargate (OpenAI end user). Anthropic IPO also expected.
